result.summary: Two targeted edits to lib/letflow/design/req073-identity-user-routes.md, nothing else touched. (1) Added new Sec 1a, 'Required @moduledoc content for Letflow.Routers.Identity (AC6)', directly after Sec 1's route-wiring table -- states as a concrete build requirement (not narrative) that ELIXIR-DEV must write a @moduledoc on Letflow.Routers.Identity naming, for each of the five routes, exactly which Letflow.Identity function(s) it calls, gives the required minimum content (a 5-line list mirroring Sec 0's table), and states explicitly what CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR/REVIEWER check on re-review: the real @moduledoc string in the committed file, not this design doc. (2) In OQ-6 (Sec 'Open questions'), corrected the citation that previously listed 'REQ-072's context_test.exs throughout' alongside router_test.exs as direct-sub-router-dispatch precedent -- now states router_test.exs:104-113 is the actual precedent and explicitly notes context_test.exs's tests bypass the router entirely (call Letflow.Api.Context functions directly), so it is not evidence for this specific mechanism. No other section modified; the AC4 ordering guarantee, the 5 new Letflow.Identity domain-function proposals (Sec 7), the new Authorization.endpoint_policy_key/2 clause, the INV-2 response allowlist (Sec 3), and OQ-6's underlying test-dispatch decision (direct Letflow.Routers.Identity.call/2, bypassing AuthPipeline) all stand as previously validated.
